ios.desc:
AI-generated images pose risks when used maliciously, appearing in ads, scams, politics, dating, and entertainment. TruthPix combats misinformation by providing secure, fast, and accurate detection of AI-altered images directly on your device.
Key Features:
Private On-Device Analysis: Ensures your data remains secure.
Fast Performance: Analyzes images in under 400ms.
Advanced AI Detection: Identifies AI-generated alterations, especially in portraits.

How to Use:
Select Image: Open the app and choose a photo from your gallery.
Detect Clones: TruthPix analyzes and indicates if the image is real or cloned.

Detection Capabilities:
Techniques: Identifies GANs, Diffusion Models, Style Transfer, Latent Space Manipulation artifacts.
On-Device: Our detection capabilities are optimized for mobile devices, but stay within the limitations imposed by mobile devices regarding memory and CPU speed.
Video: Identifies most face swapping deepfakes with just a single frame from the video.

Limitations:
Focus: Primarily detects altered portraits, not inanimate objects, art, or nature.
Accuracy: In a small fraction of cases, a cloned image could be marked as real incorrectly. We are constantly updating our Machine Learning models to accommodate new cloning techniques.

Navigate the digital world confidently with TruthPix, ensuring the images you see are trustworthy.
